Welcome to Sicko Hosting. Invite friends to enjoy matches of Fortnite Chapter 1, Season 4 gameplay! All credits go to Project Era for the Launcher, and plooshi for the redirect. This is NOT and NEVER WILL be a project, only hosting. Modes like Thanos LTM, Blitz, and Playground are all bound to be hosted!
